pages.title: Loaded Terrain
pages.text: Midnight’s Bog Strider, Aether Redux quicksoil and Relics fluid-collision checks avoid synchronously generating unavailable chunks during server-side movement.$(br2)The normal loaded-terrain handlers still supply their effects. Missing terrain samples do not force new chunk tickets just to calculate movement.

pages.title: Teleports and Saving
pages.text: Vanilla support-position caches are invalidated after explicit relocations or dimension changes, avoiding stale contacts after teleports. Soul Speed and Frost Walker still use their normal handlers.$(br2)Mekanism dirty-chunk notifications are applied to available chunks or retained for a pending loaded chunk, without a blocking fetch.
